node: Transmission hardware, line fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-specific components
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the transmission-hardware node found one unusually direct underfollowed public candidate, PLPC, plus one diversified public benchmark, HUBB, and two adjacent second-order suppliers, VMI and AZZ. The strongest chokepoint mapping is PLPC because its disclosed business is hardware and systems used in construction and maintenance of overhead/underground energy and utility networks, and external context specifically flags it as a rare public pure-play for transmission hardware. HUBB is a reference leader with explicit transmission hardware kits but is much more diversified. VMI and AZZ are weaker but plausible second-order beneficiaries: VMI supplies utility transmission/distribution structures, while AZZ provides galvanizing and metal-coating services to infrastructure end-markets, potentially benefiting from higher volumes of steel-intensive grid hardware and structures. No buy/sell recommendation is implied; this is a research universe expansion only.
